examples.title: Basic key-value editor
examples.description: Edit a small set of environment-style key-value entries.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { KeyValueEditor } from '@repo/cinder';
  let entries = $state([
    { key: 'HOST', value: 'localhost' },
    { key: 'PORT', value: '3000' },
  ]);
</script>

<KeyValueEditor bind:entries />
